en.title: oioi.bio — AI narrative filmmaking studio
en.description: oioi.bio is an AI narrative filmmaking workspace for turning ideas and novels into scripts, reusable visual assets, storyboards, and generated video.
en.lede: oioi.bio is one focused workspace for turning an idea or novel into a visual story — from script and worldbuilding to storyboard and video generation.

features.title: Find the story
features.body: Import a novel or start with an idea, then shape it into a production-ready script with an AI collaborator.

features.title: Build the world
features.body: Keep characters, scenes, props and visual references coherent in one project library.

features.title: Make it move
features.body: Transform beats into shot lists, images and generated video — while keeping every version in reach.

en.workflowTitle: From the first line to the final frame.
workflowSteps: Bring in your source material and define the story.
Create the cast, locations and visual language.
Turn scenes into structured storyboards and shots.
Generate, review and iterate on every video moment.

guides.title: How to turn a novel into video
guides.body: A complete adaptation path from source text and script to reusable assets and generated shots.

guides.title: How to storyboard with AI
guides.body: Give every storyboard frame a clear narrative purpose and production context.

featureList: Character, scene, and prop asset management
en.noscript: oioi.bio is an AI narrative filmmaking studio that helps creators turn ideas, scripts, and storyboards into video. Enable JavaScript for the full interactive experience.

zh.title: oioi.bio — AI 叙事影像创作工作台
zh.description: oioi.bio 是面向创作者的 AI 叙事影像工作台：从灵感、剧本和分镜，到角色、场景与视频生成，一处完成。
zh.lede: oioi.bio 将灵感或小说串成一条清晰的创作路径：从剧本、世界观到分镜与视频生成，都在同一个工作台完成。

features.title: 找到故事
features.body: 导入小说或从一个想法开始，与 AI 协作整理成可制作的剧本。

features.title: 构建世界
features.body: 在项目资产库中统一管理角色、场景、道具和视觉参考，让画面始终一致。

features.title: 让画面动起来
features.body: 将剧情节拍转为镜头、分镜图和生成视频，并随时保留每一次创作版本。

zh.workflowTitle: 从第一行文字，到最后一帧画面。
workflowSteps: 导入素材，定义你要讲述的故事。
创建角色、场景和整部作品的视觉语言。
将场景变成结构化的分镜与镜头。
生成、审阅并迭代每一个视频瞬间。
zh.guidesTitle: 把复杂的制作过程，讲清楚。

guides.title: 小说如何变成视频
guides.body: 从原始文本、剧本和资产，到逐镜头生成的完整改编路径。

guides.title: 如何用 AI 设计分镜
guides.body: 让每一格分镜都带着明确的叙事目的与制作信息。

featureList: 角色、场景和道具资产管理
zh.noscript: oioi.bio 是一个 AI 叙事影像创作工作台，可帮助创作者将灵感、剧本和分镜发展为视频作品。请启用 JavaScript 以使用完整功能。
